ios.desc:
Turn your iPhone into a powerful habit tracker with Habit Heatmap. See your consistency at a glance with a beautiful GitHub-style heatmap that shows your progress over time.

BUILD BETTER HABITS
Track any habit you want to build - workouts, reading, meditation, studying, or daily walks. Each day you complete your habit, you'll see it reflected in your personalized heatmap.

VISUAL MOTIVATION
The color-coded heatmap makes it easy to spot patterns in your behavior. Watch your streaks grow and stay motivated by seeing your progress build up day by day. The more consistent you are, the greener your heatmap becomes.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Keep your goals front and center with beautiful home screen widgets. Choose from multiple sizes to fit your home screen perfectly. Your progress is always visible, giving you that extra nudge to maintain your streak.

KEY FEATURES
• GitHub-style heatmap visualization
• Track multiple habits simultaneously
• Home screen widgets in multiple sizes
• Track streaks and view statistics
• Private and secure - all data stored on your device
• iCloud sync across your devices
• No account required
• No ads, no subscriptions

PRIVACY FIRST
Your habit data stays completely private. Everything is stored securely on your device and syncs via iCloud if you choose. No external servers, no data collection, no tracking.

Whether you're trying to establish a new workout routine, build a reading habit, or maintain any daily practice, Habit Heatmap helps you stay consistent and motivated through simple, beautiful visualization.

Start building better habits today!

quotes.text:
Turns out I'm motivated by little green squares. I code every day just to keep my GitHub streak alive, so I thought: why not use this power for good?
Now I have a heatmap widget on my home screen for going to the gym. Watching those green squares pile up hits different than any fitness app I've tried. It's shallow, but it works.
I got fed up with existing habit trackers—too many had subscriptions for what's basically a calendar with colors. So I built this in a month while learning Swift. It's my first native iOS app (I usually work on boring B2B apps), and I'm honestly impressed with how smooth SwiftUI made everything.
Features:
* GitHub-style heatmap widgets
* iCloud sync
* Everything stored locally, no accounts
* One-time purchase (because I refuse to add another subscription to my life)
The green squares now guilt me into working out. Mission accomplished.
My goal: keep building apps until I can afford an Apple Vision Pro. If you want to support me, check it out!
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/habit-heatmap/6747598515
